Author: @n64fan60
Content:
For about 2 seconds, I thought the fabled 80% build from early '97 had leaked! 😂

For those who care to know more, this mod is built on top of a leaked 40% build from October/November '96. 

Somewhere deep in the vaults of private collectors is rumored to exist an 80% complete build from February/March of '97, just before Capcom cancelled it and started again.

Props to such a huge YouTuber playing this mod of the leaked 40% build, which represents over a decade of work from the individual known as 'MartinBiohazard'. 

The first version of this mod was released way back in March 2013, and he has never abandoned it, this latest version being from January 2025.

If it sounds interesting to you, there is a great documentary about the hunt for this game on YouTube.

Author: @RetroZva
Content:
Just to clarify: what Charlie’s playing isn’t a 95% build. It’s a rom hack called the MZD build, based on the 40% press release version sent to Capcom USA. MZD is a clone-engine hack that reconstructs some missing elements using trailers, images, and broken scripts—but much of it is guesswork. There are official builds beyond this (~60% and 65–80%), but they’ve never leaked.

It’s important to distinguish between MZD (a fan-made reconstruction), the raw 40% vanilla build, and other earlier/later official versions. Many people wrongly treat MZD as if it were a nearly finished build, without realizing how much creative interpretation was involved. Tons of scripted events, bosses, puzzles, and core story elements are missing or speculative. Presenting it as the “original vision” is misleading.

The 40% build is the only official version that ever leaked, and the story of how it surfaced is legendary. Other builds do exist, and while we have footage and screenshots of some, they remain hidden—hoarded by collectors or kept secret due to fear of backlash or legal threats. Capcom has even taken action against someone just for sharing pictures of the final 65–80% build.

Also, while MartinBiohazard gets most of the credit for MZD patches, Juvenal Da Corte deserves equal recognition. His contributions are exceptional and often unfairly overlooked.

I just don’t want newcomers seeing 1.5 for the first time to walk away misinformed or with a distorted understanding of what this game actually was.

I’m the creator of the 1.5 subreddit—feel free to ask if you have questions.

Author: @carnivol
Content:
That's Martin Biohazard's mod for the 1.5 build THIA/IGAS released back in the day. The majority of the scenario structure, rooms and renders, dialog and event scripting, etc. in that one is fanmade by Martin Biohazard and his team. The original Capcom build this and other mods were based off of is very basic and content lacking. The build used was compiled roughly a few months prior to the point of cancellation -- before they spent the better half of a year to retool the game into the all-time classic we ultimately got.

The original ISO, without any mods, is available on Hidden Palace, same with all the other stuff THIA released back in the day.
